note: Every explanation the Dashboard shows on hover or in point mode. Plain words; every Ingence term used is defined in the glossary. A control's data-help attribute names its key; `auto` gives a key, by selector and in order (the first rule that matches wins), to controls the pages build themselves and that carry none. A key the catalog lacks shows nothing and is logged once, so a missing explanation is found in review.

help.point.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.point.text: Opens the list of keyboard shortcuts for every view. From the list, you can also have each control on this page explained.

project.name.title: Project name
project.name.text: The name you gave the project shows in magenta. A project without a name shows its folder's name in gray.

project.rename.title: Rename
project.rename.text: Gives the project a name. Only the name changes.

page.history.title: History
page.history.text: Every scan, the answers applied in each, and what changed between two scans.

footer.docs.title: Documentation
footer.docs.text: Opens the Ingence documentation, ingence.org, in a new tab. The Dashboard fetches nothing from it.

footer.report.title: Report a problem
footer.report.text: Shows a report for hello@ingence.org: versions, counts and changed settings, with no folder, file, person or project names. You read it, then send it yourself.

landing.link.title: Open another project
landing.link.text: Opens the start page: the projects on this computer, and a new one. Another project opens in its own window.

landing.first.overview.title: Overview
landing.first.overview.text: What is here, from when, and how complete it is. Start here when the scan ends.

landing.first.overlap.title: Overlap
landing.first.overlap.text: How experiments connect: shared words, the same workflow, the same instrument and repeats.

landing.first.experiments.title: Experiments
landing.first.experiments.text: Each experiment’s story: its files, its steps and what was analyzed.

section.inventory.title: Inventory
section.inventory.text: What is here, by file type, extension and folder depth. It shows what Ingence could not decide beside what it could.

section.questions.title: Questions
section.questions.text: Ingence's results first, then the few questions that matter, then the rest. Each answer is saved at once and waits for Re-run.

section.groupings.title: Word groups
section.groupings.text: Files and folders that seem to belong together. Ingence suggests them and groups nothing until you say yes.

section.claims.title: Conclusion samples
section.claims.text: A few files for each result a rule found. Say whether the rule reads your files right.

section.candidates.title: Suggested pairs
section.candidates.text: Pairs of files where one seems to be made from the other. Confirm or reject each pair.

section.extensions.title: Extensions
section.extensions.text: File extensions Ingence does not know yet, and what you say each one is.

section.programs.title: Programs
section.programs.text: Folders that look like an installed program or a code package. Say whether each one is, and Ingence keeps it apart from your data.

section.coverage.title: Coverage
section.coverage.text: What Ingence has not read yet, and why. Your answers change only the order in which Ingence reads contents.

section.rules.title: Rules
section.rules.text: The rules Ingence applies, each in plain words, with how many results of this scan depend on it.

section.settings.title: Settings
section.settings.text: How Ingence scans: what it lists, reads and hashes. A change is a draft until you commit it.

section.dictionary.title: Dictionary
section.dictionary.text: Every word Ingence knows in names: its spellings, its kind, where it came from, and how many names it matches.

dictionary.search.title: Find a word
dictionary.search.text: Type part of a word or a spelling. The list changes as you type.

dictionary.yours.title: Yours
dictionary.yours.text: The words you and others on this project added or answered.

dictionary.origin.title: Where it came from
dictionary.origin.text: Core words ship with Ingence. Other words come from a domain word list, a laboratory word list, or your answers.

dictionary.kind.title: Kind
dictionary.kind.text: What sort of thing a word names: a technique, a unit, a stage.

dictionary.order.title: Order
dictionary.order.text: Most used first, or A to Z.

dictionary.table.title: Words
dictionary.table.text: One row per word. Choose a row to see its spellings, the names it matches, and the answers about it.

dictionary.add.title: Add
dictionary.add.text: Adds a spelling to a listed word, or a new word with its kind. It is saved as yours and applies at the next Re-run.

dictionary.inactivate.title: Inactivate
dictionary.inactivate.text: The word stops matching names at the next Re-run. Nothing is deleted, and you can bring it back.

dictionary.reactivate.title: Bring back
dictionary.reactivate.text: The word matches names again at the next Re-run.

dictionary.packs.title: Word lists
dictionary.packs.text: The domain word lists that ship with Ingence, and lists installed here. A list adds words and decides nothing.

dictionary.pack_answer.title: Accept or refuse
dictionary.pack_answer.text: Accept loads or keeps the word list. Refuse stops loading it and stops the question, from the next Re-run.

dictionary.collisions.title: Shared spellings
dictionary.collisions.text: Where a shipped word list and the core share a spelling, Ingence uses the core's meaning. A laboratory list ties with the core until you choose.

dictionary.pack_remove.title: Remove
dictionary.pack_remove.text: Ingence stops loading the word list from the next Re-run. The file you installed it from stays as it is.

dictionary.import.title: Install from a file
dictionary.import.text: Installs a word list file, such as one exported here.

dictionary.export.title: Export yours
dictionary.export.text: Saves your words and answers as a word list file, with the words you inactivated.

dictionary.copy.title: Copy as YAML
dictionary.copy.text: Copies this word as an entry for a word list file, to paste under entries:. It changes nothing here.

workspace.commit.title: Commit
workspace.commit.text: Saves your draft changes to the project, with a note of what and why. Re-run then applies them.

transfer.import.title: Import
transfer.import.text: Reads a file of answers or settings, and saves the answers under their author's name. Settings come in as drafts.

transfer.export.title: Export
transfer.export.text: Saves what this page holds as a file on this computer. The button's own help says what it saves.

transfer.take_settings.title: Take as drafts
transfer.take_settings.text: Makes the imported values drafts. Commit to keep them.

transfer.done.title: Hide
transfer.done.text: Hides what the last import saved. The answer log keeps it.

workspace.rerun.title: Re-run
workspace.rerun.text: Applies every change since the last scan; press the number to see the changes by kind. Ingence says which changes you start in a terminal.

workspace.waiting.title: Waiting for Re-run
workspace.waiting.text: How many changes wait, by kind. Open a kind to see each change.

workspace.notice.title: Since the last scan
workspace.notice.text: Later closes this line until another change waits.

workspace.stop.title: Stop
workspace.stop.text: Stops the scan. Ingence asks first and says what it keeps.

workspace.not_ready.title: Last finished scan
workspace.not_ready.text: A new scan is running. The views show the last finished scan until the new one is ready.

section.changes.title: Changes
section.changes.text: Every scan, oldest first, with the answers applied in it. Compare any two side by side.

review.answer.title: Your answer
review.answer.text: Saved in the answer log under your name when you choose it. A later answer on the same row is saved as a new answer.

review.note.title: A note
review.note.text: Your own words, saved with your answer or alone. Click a word chip below it to keep that word with this row.

review.filter.title: Narrow the list
review.filter.text: Show only the questions of one kind or from one rule.

review.answered.title: Answered rows
review.answered.text: Rows you answered leave the list. This brings them back so you can change an answer.

review.define.title: Define this word
review.define.text: Say what this word means here. It applies at the next Re-run.

coverage.worth_reading.title: Read first
coverage.worth_reading.text: Says whether Ingence reads files with this extension early. An answer never stops Ingence from reading a file.

history.compare.title: Compare two scans
history.compare.text: Shows what changed between the two scans you choose. Each Re-run makes a new scan, even one that only applies the rules.

decider.name.title: Your name
decider.name.text: Ingence saves this name with every answer you give on this computer. It is kept in your own settings, outside the project.

reorganised.notice.title: Files moved
reorganised.notice.text: Files moved since an earlier scan. Your answers stay as written; this shows where the files went.

review.where.title: Where this meaning applies
review.where.text: Everywhere is the usual choice, because a word usually means the same across the laboratory. The other choice keeps the meaning to one folder and what is inside it.

review.group.title: Several rows at once
review.group.text: Saves a note, and a word every selected row offers, to each selected row as its own answer. Select rows with the boxes on the left.

review.kind.title: What kind of thing it is
review.kind.text: A reagent, a technique, a condition, and so on. The kind sets which rules can use the word, so choose the closest one.

history.what_changed.title: What changed
history.what_changed.text: This scan beside the one before it: which words Ingence read differently, and which results changed.

programs.answer.title: Answer about this folder
programs.answer.text: Opens the question beside the list. Say whether this folder is the program it looks like, or not a program at all.

programs.not_a_program.title: Not a program
programs.not_a_program.text: Says this folder is not an installed program or package. The next scan reads it as data, and you can take this back.

claims.for_all.title: One answer for every file like it
claims.for_all.text: Saves your answer for every file the rule gave the same value, one answer per file. A file you already answered keeps its answer.

folder.annotate.title: Annotate this folder
folder.annotate.text: Say in your own words what the folder holds. Ingence saves it in the answer log as a note and changes no result.

settings.value.title: A setting's value
settings.value.text: The value in use. A change is a draft until you commit it.

settings.source.title: Where the value comes from
settings.source.text: Opens the settings file that sets this value. The Dashboard never edits settings.yaml.

settings.default.title: Use the default
settings.default.text: Puts the value back to Ingence's default. After you commit, the setting is no longer marked as chosen.

graph.center.title: Choose the center
graph.center.text: Search for a folder or file by a word from its name. Or use Show connections on a file or folder.

graph.relations.title: Relations
graph.relations.text: Which lines to draw: contains, produced from, mentions. Turning one off keeps every item in place.

graph.proposals.title: Suggested pairs
graph.proposals.text: Pairs a rule suggested that nobody confirmed, drawn dashed. They are off at first; answer them on Suggested pairs.

graph.caps.title: What is left out
graph.caps.text: The most items and lines drawn, one step from the center. Past a limit, it says how many it left out, or that it could not count them.

graph.legend.title: How to read a line
graph.legend.text: A thin line means a folder contains it, and a thick arrow means the scan published it. A dashed line is only a suggestion.

graph.ladders.title: Folder levels
graph.ladders.text: The levels from data folder down to area, theme, experiment and file. A tinted band groups the items of one chain of levels.

graph.layout.title: The drawing
graph.layout.text: The center's folder is above it, and the rest is in rows below. The distance on the page is not evidence.

graph.list.title: The same content as a list
graph.list.text: The drawing as tables, for the keyboard or a screen reader. Choose a row to see its evidence.

graph.inspector.title: What is selected
graph.inspector.text: For a file or folder: where it is and what the last scan did. For a line: its relation, direction, rule, version and evidence.

graph.run.title: Which scan this is
graph.run.text: The scan the graph was read from. While Ingence applies an answer, the graph stays on the last finished scan.

graph.unresolved.title: What could not be connected
graph.unresolved.text: Relations whose other end is not in this scan. They are listed and not drawn, because drawing them would invent an item.

graph.mentions.title: What this file mentions
graph.mentions.text: The paths written inside this file. It counts how many name one file, how many are unclear, and how many name nothing here.

graph.recentre.title: Center here
graph.recentre.text: Draws the graph again around this item. Back returns to the center before.

graph.records.title: The records behind it
graph.records.text: The identifiers of the line, the suggested pair and the observations behind it, so you can look each one up.

graph.review.title: Answer this pair
graph.review.text: Opens this pair on Suggested pairs, where you answer it. The graph saves nothing.

graph.view_in_graph.title: Show connections
graph.view_in_graph.text: Opens Connections, in Advanced, centered on this folder or file.

graph.not_drawn.title: What these filters leave out
graph.not_drawn.text: Lines touching this item that these choices leave out. Ingence counts them, so a quiet drawing does not look empty.

focus.open.title: Open what you are looking at
focus.open.text: Shows the file, folder, question, scan or word you are looking at in the side panel. Each page keeps its own, after a reload too.

focus.clear.title: Stop following
focus.clear.text: Stops following the item you were looking at. Nothing is changed.

inspector.word.title: A word's page
inspector.word.text: Opens the word: its meaning here, where the meaning comes from, and where the word is used. You can give your own meaning.

inspector.file.title: Open this file
inspector.file.text: Shows the file or folder: what the scan saved, what each word of its name means, and each rule's result.

inspector.correct.title: Give the word your own meaning
inspector.correct.text: For a word that means something else in your data. Your meaning is saved in the answer log and applies at the next Re-run.

state.retry.title: Try again
state.retry.text: Tries again. The reason it stopped is shown above, in Ingence's words.

rules.search.title: Find a rule
rules.search.text: Type words from a rule's name, its plain sentence or its group's heading. Rules without every word you typed are hidden.

rules.group.title: A group of rules
rules.group.text: Opens or closes the rules that do one kind of work. The header says how many rules it holds and their results in this scan.

rules.expand.title: Open or close every group
rules.expand.text: Opens every group of rules, or closes them all. A search opens the groups that match.

rules.copy.title: Copy as a revision
rules.copy.text: Copies the change for your project's own rules file: the rule with its values, or switched off. It changes nothing here.

rules.switch_off.title: How to switch off
rules.switch_off.text: Shows the file that switches this rule off, for your project's rulebook folder. Nothing changes until you save it.

rules.conclusions.title: Its results
rules.conclusions.text: Opens the results of this rule in this scan, in Questions.

rules.link.title: Open this rule
rules.link.text: Opens the rule in Rules, in Advanced. Point at it to read it in plain words.

rules.inactive.title: Inactive rules
rules.inactive.text: Rules switched off or replaced, each with the reason. None applies to the next scan.

rules.parameter.title: A setting of this rule
rules.parameter.text: A change here is saved as a draft at once. It applies after you commit it and Re-run.

review.pager.title: 50 rows at a time
review.pager.text: The page shows 50 rows at a time. Move to the next 50 or back.

groupings.resolutions.title: Groups you approved
groupings.resolutions.text: Approving a set of words groups every experiment with exactly those words. Ingence asks about each difference on its own.

history.by_hand.title: By hand
history.by_hand.text: The commands that do the same in a terminal, in this project's folder.

history.restore.title: Restore a scan
history.restore.text: Shows what going back would change, before anything happens. Nothing is deleted when you confirm.

history.jobs.title: Jobs
history.jobs.text: After an answer or a commit, a job reads the names again and applies the rules. It continues if you close the browser page.

workspace.years.title: Experiment date range
workspace.years.text: Ingence reads a number in a name as a year only inside this range. Without a range, it uses 2013 to the present.

groupings.approve.title: Approve the words as a group
groupings.approve.text: Untick any word that does not make these experiments one group, then approve. Ingence saves it in the answer log under your name.

groupings.lattice.title: Word groups experiments share
groupings.lattice.text: Each word group is exactly the words some experiments share. Ingence asks first about the group most experiments share, then about each group that adds words.

groupings.howto.title: How to read the word groups
groupings.howto.text: Opens a picture of the word groups below, with each mark numbered and explained. Opening it answers nothing.

groupings.compare_box.title: Compare this word group
groupings.compare_box.text: Tick 2 to 4 word groups to see their words, experiments and files side by side. Ticking saves nothing.

groupings.compare_tray.title: Groups to compare
groupings.compare_tray.text: The ticked groups, each with its letter in the comparison and on the map. Compare opens them side by side.

groupings.show_on_map.title: Show on the map
groupings.show_on_map.text: Opens the Map of groups with this group's experiments outlined and zoomed in.

compare.howto.title: How to read the comparison
compare.howto.text: Opens a picture of the comparison with each mark numbered and explained.

compare.words.title: Words compared
compare.words.text: The words every compared group has, and the words only one group has. Each count is out of the words in any group.

compare.experiments.title: Experiments compared
compare.experiments.text: How many experiments are in every group, out of those in any. In each bar, dark is in every group, middle in some, light in that group only.

compare.files.title: Files compared
compare.files.text: The files in each group's experiments. Files in common are the files of the experiments in common.

compare.show_on_map.title: Show the groups on the map
compare.show_on_map.text: Opens the Map of groups with each group outlined and lettered. Ingence shades the part where two outlines meet.

groupings.lattice_mode.title: How this scan asked
groupings.lattice_mode.text: By word groups, largest first, or the earlier way, with one question for each word added or missing. Change it in Rules, in Advanced.

section.explorer.title: Explorer
section.explorer.text: The Wheel, Lineage and Timeline show what a folder holds and how its files led to one another. One selection works across all three.

section.neighbourhood.title: Connections
section.neighbourhood.text: One folder or file and what is directly around it: its folder, contents, sources and mentions, each with its evidence.

section.map.title: Map of groups
section.map.text: Every experiment as a dot, placed by the words its themes use. Experiments with similar words lie close; distances are approximate.

map.color_by.title: Color by
map.color_by.text: One measure at a time: the theme, how much raw data was analyzed, or the year. The key under the map explains each color.

map.plot.title: The map
map.plot.text: Point at a dot for its name, and click it for its card. Click a theme's name to keep its experiments and fade the rest.

map.tools.title: Zoom and names
map.tools.text: Zoom in, zoom out or reset, and show or hide the theme names. The keys + - 0 and L do the same.

map.legend.title: What the colors mean
map.legend.text: What each color of the measure stands for. Hatching is an experiment with no value for this measure.

map.unplaced.title: Experiments not placed
map.unplaced.text: An experiment with none of the words the themes use has no place on the map. It is listed here instead.

map.card.title: The experiment clicked
map.card.text: Its name, folder, theme, year, files and analysis, and how many experiments share its place.

map.stability.title: The theme's stability
map.stability.text: How well the theme holds when Ingence draws the groups again, from 0 (chance) to 1 (identical). Below the tick, the theme is uncertain.

map.open_years.title: Open in Overlap
map.open_years.text: Opens this experiment in the Overlap view.

map.relations.title: Relations
map.relations.text: Opens the files around this experiment in Connections. Press N.

map.howto.title: How to read the map
map.howto.text: Opens a picture of the map with each mark numbered and explained. Opening it changes nothing on the map.

map.compare.title: Compare themes
map.compare.text: Tick 2 to 4 themes, then compare their words, experiments and files. Each theme is outlined on the map, and the overlap is shaded.

map.outlines.title: Outlines
map.outlines.text: An outline is the smallest round shape around one group's experiments, with a letter at its edge. A dot of another group can lie inside it.

map.groups.title: The groups outlined
map.groups.text: Each group on the map, how many of its experiments have a place, and a way to remove its outline.

map.show_stack.title: Show the word group
map.show_stack.text: Opens the word group these words belong to, opened and marked.

section.years.title: Overlap
section.years.text: Themes and experiments over time, one row each, from the whole project down to one file. Click a row to read about it.

section.topics.title: Collections
section.topics.text: Your own named sets of experiments, word groups and themes. Each one shows what it holds in this scan and what changed since the last.

topics.choose.title: Add to
topics.choose.text: Choose a collection you made, or name a new one. Ingence saves this in the answer log, and nothing waits for Re-run.

topics.name.title: The collection's name
topics.name.text: What you call the set, in up to 120 characters. You can rename it later.

topics.pickbar.title: Picked for a collection
topics.pickbar.text: What you picked on this page. Choose Add to collection to put it in a collection, or Clear to start over.

topics.clear_picks.title: Clear what you picked
topics.clear_picks.text: Removes everything you picked on this page. Nothing is saved.

topics.add.title: Add to collection
topics.add.text: Puts what you picked into a new or existing collection. Ingence saves it in the answer log under your name.

topics.chip.title: A collection of yours
topics.chip.text: A collection that holds this. Click it to open the collection.

topics.chips.title: Your collections
topics.chips.text: Your collections that hold this row's experiments. For a row of several experiments, the numbers say how many of them each collection holds.

topics.more.title: More experiments
topics.more.text: Shows the next page of this collection's experiments.

topics.rename.title: Rename
topics.rename.text: Gives the collection another name. The answer log keeps the earlier name.

topics.remove_member.title: Remove
topics.remove_member.text: Removes this member from the collection and keeps the others. You cannot remove the last member; withdraw the collection instead.

topics.withdraw.title: Withdraw
topics.withdraw.text: Stops showing the collection on the views. The answer log keeps what you said and when.

topics.export.title: Export files (CSV)
topics.export.text: Saves a spreadsheet of the files in the collection's experiments, with path, data folder, name, stage and experiment. Your browser saves it as a download.

topics.show_years.title: Show on Overlap
topics.show_years.text: Opens Overlap with only this collection's experiments. Clear the collection there to see every experiment again.

topics.show_map.title: Show on the Map
topics.show_map.text: Opens the Map with this collection's outline drawn and zoomed in.

topics.flag_nothing.title: Members that match no experiment
topics.flag_nothing.text: Some members name something this scan does not have, such as a folder that moved. They stay listed, with the reason.

topics.flag_unread.title: Members Ingence could not read
topics.flag_unread.text: Ingence could not read a member of this collection in this scan. Its counts are a minimum, and the true number is unknown.

topics.flag_drift.title: Changed since the last scan
topics.flag_drift.text: How many experiments joined or left the collection since the scan before. The card gives the reason for each.

topics.starts.title: Places to start
topics.starts.text: Ingence's broadest themes, offered as places to start a collection. Nothing is made until you choose.

topics.suggestion.title: Start a collection from it
topics.suggestion.text: Makes a collection with a name you choose, holding this theme's experiments one by one.

groups.pick.title: Pick a word group for a collection
groups.pick.text: Ticks this word group. A collection that holds a word group follows its words, so new experiments with those words join it.

years.pick.title: Pick for a collection
years.pick.text: Shows a box on each theme and experiment. Tick some, then choose Add to collection.

years.pick_row.title: Pick this row
years.pick_row.text: Ticks this row for a collection.

years.lens.title: Collection
years.lens.text: Shows only the experiments of one of your collections, at every level. Choose every experiment to see them all.

years.wheel_topics.title: Your collections on the Wheel
years.wheel_topics.text: The thin rings outside the Wheel are your collections, one ring each. A ring is drawn where the collection holds an experiment.

map.topics.title: Your collections on the map
map.topics.text: Each switch draws the outline of one collection's experiments, in its color. Shift-click dots, or Shift-drag a box, to pick them for a collection.

section.found.title: No analysis found
section.found.text: Experiments with raw data where Ingence found no analysis in the files it read. If the analysis is elsewhere, say so, and the next scan leaves it out.

section.manifest.title: What changed
section.manifest.text: Each scan, with what changed from the scan before it, and the answers applied in it.

section.ladders.title: Folder levels
section.ladders.text: The levels the Overlap view uses for each kind of data folder. It shows what a row is at each level, and where it comes from.

years.chip.title: A choice
years.chip.text: One of the ways to draw this scale.

years.measure.title: Color by
years.measure.text: What the color shows: how much raw data was analyzed, or whether a person noted something (magenta).

years.wheel.title: The Wheel
years.wheel.text: The current scale as rings: broad themes, themes, experiments. The angle is how many, and the color follows the measure.

years.details.title: Details
years.details.text: In a narrow window, the card of the selected item waits in a drawer. This opens it; Escape or Close shuts it.

years.drawer_close.title: Close the drawer
years.drawer_close.text: Closes the card and returns to the rows. Escape does the same.

years.sheet_close.title: Close the Wheel
years.sheet_close.text: Closes the Wheel and returns to the rows. Escape does the same.

years.overlap_draw.title: Draw shared words as
years.overlap_draw.text: A matrix shows every theme against every other, readable up to 12 themes. A ring shows only the pairs that share a word.

years.wheel_key.title: A theme around the Wheel
years.wheel_key.text: Its number, full name and number of experiments. A narrow arc shows only the number; click to choose the theme.

years.narrow_search.title: Search experiments
years.narrow_search.text: Goes to the search box at the top of the page.

years.narrow_questions.title: Questions
years.narrow_questions.text: Opens Questions, where Ingence asks what it could not decide. The number is how many questions come first.

years.rows_are.title: Rows are
years.rows_are.text: What a row is at the experiment scale: folders, stages, file types, or each file.

years.design.title: Design grid
years.design.text: The conditions in this experiment's file names, as a grid of every combination. Each cell is shaded by how many times it was repeated.

years.design_grid.title: The grid
years.design_grid.text: A hatched cell is a combination no name has, and an outlined cell has empty output. The number is how many times it was repeated.

years.filter.title: Filter
years.filter.text: Keeps only the files whose name, folder, stage or type contains this.

years.busy.title: The busiest days
years.busy.text: The days that hold most of this experiment's files. The view opens on them, and you can choose the whole range.

years.axis.title: The time axis
years.axis.text: Pinch, or press Ctrl and scroll, to zoom around the pointer. Drag, or scroll sideways, to move. Click a year to see what happened then.

years.word.title: A word
years.word.text: Opens the word's page: what it means here, where it came from, and how to give it another meaning.

years.action.title: An action
years.action.text: Opens or moves to what the card describes.

years.rename.title: Name this theme
years.rename.text: Your name for this theme, saved under your name. Ingence's own words stay underneath.

years.elsewhere.title: Analyzed elsewhere
years.elsewhere.text: Say that this experiment's analysis is in a place Ingence did not read. The next scan leaves it off the No analysis found list.

years.inventory.title: Inventory
years.inventory.text: Everything Ingence counted when it listed the files: file types, sizes and folders. Opens the Inventory page.

years.questions.title: Questions
years.questions.text: The questions Ingence asks, the most useful first. Opens Questions, in Advanced.

years.map.title: Map of groups
years.map.text: Where each experiment lies by the words its theme uses. Opens the Map of groups, in Advanced.

years.more_lines.title: More themes
years.more_lines.text: Shows every theme in a list that scrolls, or folds the list back to 4.

years.unplaced.title: In no theme
years.unplaced.text: The experiments no theme holds, because their words are too far from the others. Opens them as rows.

years.no_analysis.title: No analysis found
years.no_analysis.text: The experiments of this theme with raw data and no analysis in the files Ingence read. Opens the list.

years.open_theme.title: Open its experiments
years.open_theme.text: One scale down: the experiments of this theme as rows.

years.open_files.title: Open its files
years.open_files.text: One scale down: the files of this experiment as rows.

years.rule_row.title: A rule's result
years.rule_row.text: Opens the rule that found it, its version, and the evidence it read.

years.record.title: File details
years.record.text: Everything Ingence saved about this file: its name's parts, its clocks, and every result with its rule.

years.teach.title: Teach a word
years.teach.text: Lists the words of this file's name. Open one to see its meaning here, and to give your own.

years.same_columns.title: Same columns
years.same_columns.text: Opens the files one by one, only the tables with the same columns as this one.

years.graph.title: Connections
years.graph.text: Opens Connections centered on it: its sources, what was made from it, and what mentions it.

found.row.title: An experiment
found.row.text: Click or press Enter to open the experiment's folder beside the list.

found.elsewhere.title: Analyzed elsewhere
found.elsewhere.text: Says this experiment's analysis is in a place Ingence did not read. The next scan leaves it off the list.

found.not_elsewhere.title: Not elsewhere
found.not_elsewhere.text: Takes back that this experiment's analysis is elsewhere. The next scan lists it again.

found.note.title: Note
found.note.text: Where the analysis is, in your words, such as another drive or folder. It stays with the answer.

found.thresholds.title: Thresholds
found.thresholds.text: The settings Ingence used for this list, each by its name in Advanced > Settings.

manifest.run.title: A scan
manifest.run.text: Open it to see what changed from the scan before it, and the answers applied in it.

manifest.why.title: Why
manifest.why.text: Ingence's own sentence for this answer, and where it is in the answer log.

manifest.more.title: Show the others
manifest.more.text: Shows the rest of this scan's sentences.

manifest.quality.title: Quality figures
manifest.quality.text: Counts of what this scan found and read, beside the scan it is compared with. Point at a figure to see how it is counted.

state.check_again.title: Check again
state.check_again.text: Checks again whether Ingence can reach this project's data folder. It reads nothing inside it.

state.show_last_run.title: Show the last scan
state.show_last_run.text: Folds the notice to one line so the last scan has more room. Details brings the notice back.

state.run_rules.title: Run the rules now
state.run_rules.text: Applies the rules to the listed files in the background, and shows this page when they finish. It reads only the project, never your data folders.

questions.answer.title: Answer
questions.answer.text: Saves your answer under your name at once. It waits for Re-run.

questions.change.title: Change
questions.change.text: Opens the answers again so you can change yours. The answer log keeps the earlier answer.

questions.kind.title: Kind and rule version
questions.kind.text: The kind of question, and the version of the rule that asks it.

questions.stands.title: Where the word appears
questions.stands.text: Searches the folder for names that contain this word.

questions.note.title: Note
questions.note.text: A note saved with your answer in the answer log.

questions.own_words.title: In your own words
questions.own_words.text: Say what the word means in your own words, and what kind of thing it is.

questions.why.title: Why this is asked
questions.why.text: Which rule asks this question, its version, and what that rule finds.

questions.ranking.title: How the ranking works
questions.ranking.text: How Ingence orders the questions: it compares one fact at a time, and weights or adds nothing.

questions.chip.title: The rest of the questions
questions.chip.text: Opens this kind of question as a table, 50 rows a page, with filters for area and rule.

questions.elsewhere.title: Elsewhere
questions.elsewhere.text: Questions that wait on other tabs, and how many wait on each.

questions.select.title: Choose rows
questions.select.text: Chooses every row in this table, or none. With rows chosen, a bar above the table answers them together.

questions.bulk.title: Answer together
questions.bulk.text: Saves this answer for every chosen row, one answer each with the same note. It waits for Re-run.

questions.next.title: Next question
questions.next.text: Opens the next question still waiting for an answer, in the order the tables show them.

years.show_on_map.title: Show on the map
years.show_on_map.text: Opens the Map of groups with this theme's experiments outlined and zoomed in.

section.experiments.title: Experiments
section.experiments.text: Every experiment Ingence found, how complete each one is, and how its files were linked to it. Filter, sort, and open a row to see its files.

experiments.assumption.title: What Ingence assumes about pairs
experiments.assumption.text: A raw file counts as analyzed when a pair or link joins it to an analysis file or results table. Ingence takes its own pairs as right.

experiments.filter_name.title: Filter by name
experiments.filter_name.text: Keeps the experiments whose name or folder holds what you type. The list changes as you type.

experiments.filter_person.title: Filter by area
experiments.filter_person.text: Keeps the experiments of one area. An area is the folder level your settings name, such as the top folders of a data folder.

experiments.filter_line.title: Filter by theme
experiments.filter_line.text: Keeps the experiments in one theme. Ingence finds themes from the words experiments share.

experiments.filter_topic.title: Filter by collection
experiments.filter_topic.text: Keeps the experiments in one of your collections. Ingence never uses a collection to find results.

experiments.topics.title: Collections
experiments.topics.text: Your collections that hold this experiment, each a magenta chip. If Ingence could not read a collection, the table says so above.

experiments.topic_chip.title: A collection
experiments.topic_chip.text: Shows only the experiments in this collection.

experiments.filter_state.title: Filter by completeness
experiments.filter_state.text: Raw and analysis found, raw only, analysis only, or neither. Each describes what Ingence found in the files it read.

experiments.sort.title: Sort and order
experiments.sort.text: Sort by name, date, files or completeness. An unknown date or share always comes last.

experiments.sort_head.title: Sort by this column
experiments.sort_head.text: Sorts the table by this column. Choose it again to reverse the order.

experiments.clear.title: Clear the filters
experiments.clear.text: Removes every filter and goes back to the first page, sorted by name.

experiments.table.title: The experiments
experiments.table.text: One row for each experiment. Counts are what Ingence found in the files it read.

experiments.row.title: An experiment
experiments.row.text: Choose its name to open its card and files in Overlap.

experiments.open.title: Open the experiment
experiments.open.text: Opens this experiment in Overlap: its card, and its files one by one.

experiments.found_by.title: How it was found
experiments.found_by.text: The rule that found this experiment. It used what the folder holds, or a date and a word in the folder's name.

experiments.files.title: Its files
experiments.files.text: The files found in the experiment. Open it to see them by stage and by file type.

experiments.followed.title: Raw files analyzed
experiments.followed.text: How many of its raw files have an analysis file or a results table, of all its raw files. With no raw files found, the count is unknown.

experiments.followed_why.title: Why this count
experiments.followed_why.text: What the count rests on: pairs you confirmed, and the pairs and links Ingence found itself, which it assumes are right.

experiments.legend.title: The bar's two shades
experiments.legend.text: Magenta counts raw files analyzed through a pair you confirmed. Gray counts those analyzed through a pair or link Ingence found itself.

experiments.pairs.title: Suggested pairs
experiments.pairs.text: Opens Suggested pairs, where you confirm or refuse a pair Ingence suggested. That list holds every pair in the scan.

experiments.characterized.title: How well it was characterized
experiments.characterized.text: Of its files, how many have a stage and how many a role. Each count is out of all files in the experiment.

experiments.why.title: Why this state
experiments.why.text: How Ingence judged the state. It uses the No analysis found test, or what it found when there are too few raw files.

experiments.state.title: Completeness
experiments.state.text: Whether Ingence found raw files and analysis in the experiment, in the files it read. It says nothing about files Ingence did not read.

experiments.pager.title: Pages
experiments.pager.text: The table lists 50 experiments at a time. Previous and Next move through them.

section.words.title: Words
section.words.text: Teach Ingence your words: pick a word and choose its meaning. Answers wait for Re-run.

words.meter.title: How much of the names Ingence understands
words.meter.text: Counts of word parts in names. Solid is understood now, light is what your answers would add, and hatched is the rest.

words.show_answered.title: Show answered words
words.show_answered.text: Lists the words you answered, each with your answer and Withdraw. A new answer for the same place replaces it; one kept below a folder stays below that folder.

words.show_understood.title: Show words it understood
words.show_understood.text: Adds the words the Dictionary already knows, so you can confirm or correct a meaning.

words.state.title: Narrow by state
words.state.text: Shows only the words in one state, such as unknown, tied or understood. The number is how many words are in it.

words.list.title: The words
words.list.text: The words Ingence is unsure of, those in the most files first. Open a word to teach it.

words.card.title: The word's card
words.card.text: What the word means, and whether the spellings beside it are the same thing. Save, or Enter, saves your answers; nothing applies until Re-run.

words.sense.title: A meaning it already has
words.sense.text: Saves this meaning for the word under your name. The Dictionary has it for this word or a similar spelling.

words.own.title: Something else
words.own.text: Say what the word means, what kind of thing it is, and whether that holds everywhere or below one folder.

words.own_row.title: Your own meaning
words.own_row.text: Write what the word means, choose its kind, and choose where it applies. Say what it means saves it with your other answers.

words.not_a_word.title: Not a person's word
words.not_a_word.text: Says a computer or program reads this, such as an extension or a code. Then choose what it is to a computer.

words.cannot_say.title: Can't say
words.cannot_say.text: Saves a note saying you cannot tell. The word stays in the list.

words.skip.title: Skip
words.skip.text: Moves the word to the end of the list and opens the next one. Nothing is saved.

words.record.title: Save
words.record.text: Saves your answers for this word and its spellings under your name, then opens the next word. Answers wait for Re-run.

words.glued.title: One word or separate words
words.glued.text: A capital divides this spelling. One word reads it whole, and Separate words reads each piece.

words.same.title: The same thing
words.same.text: This spelling means what this word means. It is saved with the meaning you gave the word.

words.kind.title: Different things of one kind
words.kind.text: This spelling is its own thing, of the same kind as this word. You write its meaning.

words.unrelated.title: Unrelated
words.unrelated.text: The two spellings are different things. Ingence will not suggest this pair again.

words.kind_meaning.title: Its own meaning
words.kind_meaning.text: What this spelling means, of the same kind as the word. It starts as the spelling itself; change it if you like.

words.note.title: A note
words.note.text: A note stays with the answer. It is optional and changes nothing.

coverage.words.title: Teach words in Words
coverage.words.text: Teach the words that have no meaning yet in the Words section of Questions. They are ordered by how many files have them.

questions.words.title: The words Ingence is unsure of
questions.words.text: The words Ingence is unsure of that are in the most files. Teach them first, because a word's meaning changes later questions.

questions.words_link.title: Open Words
questions.words_link.text: Opens the Words section, with every word Ingence is unsure of.

words.withdraw.title: Withdraw this answer
words.withdraw.text: Takes back your answer about this word, after asking. The answer log keeps it, and it waits for Re-run like every answer.

overview.found.title: What was found
overview.found.text: How many experiments and files Ingence found, from when, and in which top folders.

overview.completeness.title: Completeness
overview.completeness.text: How many raw files were analyzed. Experiments with no analysis are listed here.

overview.ask.title: Ask
overview.ask.text: Type a question about your data. Ingence lists the experiments that match and says why.

overview.assumptions.title: Assumptions and checks
overview.assumptions.text: Assumptions are results Ingence takes as true until you correct them. Checks are questions worth a minute; where Ingence has a guess, you can keep it.

page.overview.title: Overview
page.overview.text: What the scan found, on one page. Ask a question, read the counts, and correct what Ingence assumed.

page.overlap.title: Overlap
page.overlap.text: How your experiments connect: shared words, the same workflow, the same instrument, and repeats.

page.experiments.title: Experiments
page.experiments.text: Every experiment Ingence found, and your collections.

page.checks.title: Checks
page.checks.text: The few questions that matter, one at a time. Where Ingence has a guess you can keep it; where it has none, the question waits for your answer.

page.advanced.title: Advanced
page.advanced.text: The rules, the Dictionary, the settings, every list and the other views.

section.overview.title: Overview
section.overview.text: What the scan found, on one page.

section.checks.title: Checks
section.checks.text: One question at a time, with Ingence's guess where it has one. Below it are the words that matter and every assumption.

ask.box.title: Ask
ask.box.text: Type a question about your experiments and press Enter. Ingence lists the experiments that relate to it.

overview.goal.title: Goal
overview.goal.text: One of your goals, and the experiments that relate to it. Each tier is listed apart, with its reason.

overview.show_these.title: Show these
overview.show_these.text: Opens Experiments with this goal's experiments, and lights them in Overlap.

overview.areas.title: Areas
overview.areas.text: The top-level folders in your data folders. Each one is a person, an instrument, a project, a date or a folder.

overview.area_kind.title: What an area is
overview.area_kind.text: Choose what this folder stands for, to correct the kind Ingence assumed. The change waits for Re-run.

overview.repeats.title: Repeats
overview.repeats.text: Experiments done once, and experiments done again. Seen once means one experiment supports it.

overview.themes.title: Themes
overview.themes.text: Experiments that share many words. Choose a theme to open Overlap.

overview.checks.title: Checks
overview.checks.text: The questions where one answer settles the most files. Choose one to open it in Checks.

overview.job.title: The scan
overview.job.text: The scan that is running, and how far it is. Stop stops it.

assumptions.wrong.title: This is wrong
assumptions.wrong.text: Tells Ingence this assumption is wrong. The correction waits for Re-run.

assumptions.all.title: All assumptions
assumptions.all.text: Every assumption of this scan, the most files first, each with This is wrong.

checks.quick.title: Quick checks
checks.quick.text: A few checks after the first scan, one at a time. They show once for each project.

checks.keep.title: Keep
checks.keep.text: Keeps Ingence's guess and shows the next check.

checks.next.title: Next
checks.next.text: Shows the next check. This one has no result until you answer it.

checks.change.title: Change
checks.change.text: Shows the answers to choose from. Your answer waits for Re-run.

checks.skip.title: Skip
checks.skip.text: Keeps every guess and opens the Overview. Checks lists every check later.

checks.answer.title: An answer
checks.answer.text: Saves this answer under your name. It waits for Re-run.

checks.cancel.title: Cancel
checks.cancel.text: Closes the answers and keeps the guess.

checks.move.title: Previous and Next
checks.move.text: Moves to the check before or after this one.

checks.words.title: Words that matter
checks.words.text: The spellings and meanings Ingence assumed. Each has This is wrong.

section.overlap.title: Overlap
section.overlap.text: How your experiments connect. Connections draws the experiments and the lines between them. By year lists areas, then experiments, by time.

section.stability.title: Stability
section.stability.text: How steady each theme is when Ingence groups the experiments again from other starting points. A theme below 0.80 has an uncertain boundary.

overlap.mode.title: Connections or By year
overlap.mode.text: Connections draws the experiments and how they overlap. By year lists areas, then their experiments, by date.

overlap.drawing.title: The drawing
overlap.drawing.text: Each dot is an experiment, colored by its theme. A line joins two experiments that overlap. Pinch, or hold Ctrl and scroll, to zoom.

overlap.filter_area.title: Area
overlap.filter_area.text: Shows only the experiments in one area. An area is a top-level folder inside a data folder.

overlap.filter_theme.title: Theme
overlap.filter_theme.text: Shows only the experiments of one theme.

overlap.filter_kind.title: Lines
overlap.filter_kind.text: Choose the kinds of overlap to draw. The number is how many pairs of experiments have that kind.

overlap.highlight.title: Highlight
overlap.highlight.text: The experiments that the Overview's Show these named are highlighted. The others are dimmed.

overlap.clear_highlight.title: Clear highlight
overlap.clear_highlight.text: Shows every experiment at full strength again.

overlap.legend.title: Legend
overlap.legend.text: The colors of the themes, and how each kind of line is drawn. The eight largest themes each have a color.

overlap.list.title: The lines drawn, as a list
overlap.list.text: The same lines as the drawing, one row each. Open a row to see why the two experiments overlap.

overlap.open_pair.title: Open the overlap
overlap.open_pair.text: Shows why these two experiments overlap, with the evidence for each kind.

overlap.open_node.title: Open the experiment
overlap.open_node.text: Shows this experiment's story, day by day.

overlap.evidence.title: Evidence
overlap.evidence.text: Why Ingence joined these two experiments: the shared words, the workflow, the instrument, a repeat, a copy or a source.

overlap.files.title: Show the files
overlap.files.text: Lists the files of both experiments. Files whose names hold a shared word come first.

overlap.file.title: A file
overlap.file.text: Opens what Ingence recorded about this file.

overlap.by_year.title: Open in By year
overlap.by_year.text: Opens this experiment in Overlap's By year mode, with its story and its files.

story.days.title: Days
story.days.text: One box per day with files, colored by the stage of that day's files.

story.workflow.title: Workflow
story.workflow.text: The steps this experiment's files went through, and the last step they reached.

story.repeats.title: Repeats
story.repeats.text: The experiments that Ingence reads as repeats of this one.

story.repeat.title: A repeat
story.repeat.text: Opens this repeat of the experiment.

story.made_from.title: Made from
story.made_from.text: The experiments whose files this experiment was made from.

story.files.title: Show the files
story.files.text: Lists this experiment's files, by folder.

workflow.card.title: Workflow
workflow.card.text: The steps your files go through, by file type. Ingence suggests a workflow from what it found. You can change it or turn it off.

workflow.change.title: Change
workflow.change.text: Change the file types at each step, or the order of the steps. Ingence first shows what would change.

workflow.turn_off.title: Turn off
workflow.turn_off.text: Stops Ingence from using this workflow. Ingence first shows what would change.

workflow.show_change.title: Show what changes
workflow.show_change.text: Ingence counts what your change would change. Nothing is saved yet.

workflow.change_confirm.title: Change
workflow.change_confirm.text: Saves the change. It waits for Re-run.

workflow.turn_off_confirm.title: Turn off
workflow.turn_off_confirm.text: Turns the workflow off. This waits for Re-run.

workflow.add_type.title: Add a type
workflow.add_type.text: Adds a file type of this project to this step.

workflow.remove_type.title: Remove a type
workflow.remove_type.text: Removes this file type from this step.

workflow.move.title: Move a step
workflow.move.text: Moves this step earlier or later in the workflow.

workflow.remove_stage.title: Remove a step
workflow.remove_stage.text: Removes this step from the workflow.

years.story.title: Story
years.story.text: What happened in this experiment, day by day: the stage of its files, its workflow, its repeats.

years.stability.title: Stability
years.stability.text: Opens Stability in Advanced: how stable each theme is. O opens it too.

experiments.story.title: Open the story
experiments.story.text: Shows this experiment's story under its row. Click the name again to close it.

experiments.by_year.title: Open in By year
experiments.by_year.text: Opens this experiment in Overlap's By year mode.

ask.read.title: Your question
ask.read.text: The words Ingence read in your question, the words it left out, and the words it does not know.

ask.filters.title: Filters
ask.filters.text: The years, file types and areas your question names. Ingence lists only the experiments that fit them.

ask.included.title: Words included
ask.included.text: Other words Ingence counts as yours: a spelling, a plural, or a word of the same kind in the Dictionary.

ask.tier.title: Named and Associated
ask.tier.text: Named experiments have your words in their names. Associated experiments connect to your words in another way, said on each line.

ask.same_theme.title: Same theme
ask.same_theme.text: Suggestions: experiments in the same theme as a match. Your words may not be in them.

ask.save_goal.title: Save as goal
ask.save_goal.text: Keeps this question as a goal. The Overview shows its answer card.

ask.open.title: Open an experiment
ask.open.text: Opens the experiment: its days, its files and its repeats.

assumptions.example.title: Example
assumptions.example.text: A file that rests on this assumption. Opens it in the inspector, under the line.

overview.goal_story.title: The experiment's story
overview.goal_story.text: Opens this experiment's story under it, day by day. Press it again to close the story.

experiments.goal_all.title: Show all
experiments.goal_all.text: Lists every experiment again, without the goal's filter.

groupings_stacks.title: How to read the word groups
groupings_stacks.alt: One word group from the sample. A base block at the bottom is asked now, and 7 blocks above it wait, folded under one open line.
groupings_stacks.lead: A word group is a set of words that experiments share, with every group that adds words to it. Each block counts the experiments that have all of its words.

marks.title: A word group
marks.text: A set of words that enough experiments share, 5 by default, with the groups that add words above it. The top line says how many experiments have the base words.

marks.title: The base
marks.text: The base block is the set every experiment in the group has. It is at the bottom, as wide as the group, and all its words are strong.

marks.title: A block above
marks.text: A block on another block adds words to the one below. Its width is its share of the base's experiments; point at it to outline the block it adds to.

marks.title: A strong word
marks.text: A word in a bold pill with a plus sign is one this block adds to the block below it.

marks.title: A faint word
marks.text: A gray word is one the block shares with the block below it. It is not new here.

marks.title: The state
marks.text: The tag says where the block stands: asked now, one group, not one group, waiting, or not asked. The edge shows the same with a glow, green, dashes or faded words.

marks.title: How many experiments
marks.text: How many of the base's experiments have this block's words. Open it to see their folders.

marks.title: Blocks that only wait
marks.text: Blocks that wait for the block below them fold into one line, so a tall group stays short. In this picture the line is open.

marks.title: Your answer
marks.text: Only a block asked now has these. Ingence saves One group or Not one group in the answer log under your name.

marks.title: The meter
marks.text: The bar counts the blocks in the group that are settled, out of all of them. Settled means approved, declined, or set aside because a block below was declined.

marks.title: Compare
marks.text: Tick 2 to 4 blocks, in this group or another, to see their words, experiments and files side by side. Ticking saves nothing.

marks.title: Show on the map
marks.text: Opens the Map of groups with this group's experiments outlined and zoomed in.

groupings_stacks.note: Ingence does not ask about word groups that too few experiments share. They are listed under the others, each with its number.

map.title: How to read the map
map.alt: The Map of groups of the sample, with dots in 5 colors and each theme named above a dotted ring. Groups A and B are outlined, with their overlap shaded. The key is under the map, and the card of the 2 groups is at the right.
map.lead: Each dot is one experiment. Dots that lie close use similar words. A place is approximate, so read which dots are near each other, and ignore exact distances.

marks.title: An experiment
marks.text: One dot is one experiment. Its color is the measure under Color by, and its size grows with its number of files.

marks.title: A theme
marks.text: Each theme is named once, above the middle of its experiments. Click a name to keep that theme's experiments and fade the rest.

marks.title: A dotted ring
marks.text: The ring marks the middle of a theme's experiments, the average of their places. It is not an experiment.

marks.title: An outline
marks.text: A group's outline is the smallest round shape around its experiments. A dot of another group can lie inside it.

marks.title: The letter
marks.text: The letter at an outline's edge names the group in the key and in the comparison.

marks.title: Where outlines overlap
marks.text: The gray part is where two outlines meet. It can hold a dot that is in neither group.

marks.title: The colors
marks.text: The key under the map says what each dot color stands for. Hatching is an experiment with no value for the measure.

marks.title: The outlines' key
marks.text: The Outlines button shows or hides the outlines. The key lists each outline with its letter, words and placed experiments.

marks.title: Color by
marks.text: Chooses what a dot's color means: its theme, how much of its raw data was analyzed, or its year.

marks.title: Zoom and names
marks.text: Zoom in, zoom out or reset, and show or hide the names. Drag on the map to zoom to a box, and double-click to reset.

marks.title: What the places mean
marks.text: Ingence's own sentence on how it made the places, and what they do not say.

marks.title: The groups outlined
marks.text: Each group outlined, how many of its experiments have a place, and a way to remove its outline. Click a dot to see that experiment's card here.

map.note: An experiment with none of the words the themes use has no place. Ingence does not draw it and counts it under the map.

compare.title: How to read the comparison
compare.alt: A comparison of 2 groups of the sample. It shows each group with its letter, the words in both and in one only, and the experiments in both. Below are a bar for each group, closed lists of experiments, the files, and a button for the map.
compare.lead: The comparison puts 2 to 4 groups side by side. Each group keeps its letter on the map. A group is a word group or a theme.

marks.title: The groups
marks.text: Each group with its letter, what it is, and how many experiments and files it holds. A letter's box has the same dash as its outline on the map.

marks.title: Words in all
marks.text: The words every group has, out of all the words any group has.

marks.title: Words in one only
marks.text: The words only that group has. A group with none says none.

marks.title: Experiments in all
marks.text: How many experiments are in every group, out of all the experiments in any group.

marks.title: The bars
marks.text: One bar for each group's experiments: dark are in every group, middle in some, light in that group only. The number beside it counts the light part.

marks.title: The lists
marks.text: Each list is closed until you open it. It shows the experiments in every group, or in one only, with their numbers of files.

marks.title: Files
marks.text: The files of the experiments in every group, out of the files of the experiments in any group. Shared files are the files of shared experiments.

marks.title: Show on the map
marks.text: Opens the Map of groups with each group outlined with its letter, and the overlap shaded.

compare.note: With 3 or 4 groups, the comparison also lists what each 2 groups share.
